name: shinchantw_cbt_d0_19_purchase_structure_20260729_191228_650635
sql:
-- Purchase structure through 19:00 Beijing time: TC all users vs SG Singapore Android.
WITH
tc_blacklist AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_18 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
sg_blacklist AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')),
sg_android AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'),
sg_country AS (SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" AS user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13 WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'),
tc_cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT v."#account_id" AS account_id
  FROM ta.v_event_18 v LEFT JOIN tc_blacklist b ON v."#user_id"=b.user_id
  WHERE v."$part_date"='2026-07-29' AND v."$part_event"='new_role' AND b.user_id IS NULL
    AND CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP)<TIMESTAMP '2026-07-29 19:00:00'
),
sg_cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT v."#account_id" AS account_id
  FROM ta.v_event_13 v LEFT JOIN sg_blacklist b ON v."#user_id"=b.user_id INNER JOIN sg_android a ON v."#user_id"=a.user_id INNER JOIN sg_country c ON v."#user_id"=c.user_id
  WHERE v."$part_date"='2026-05-08' AND v."$part_event"='new_role' AND b.user_id IS NULL
    AND CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP)<TIMESTAMP '2026-05-08 19:00:00'
),
tc_purchases AS (
  SELECT 'TC 全量（仅安卓）' AS cohort,CAST(TRY_CAST(v.product_id AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT) AS product_id,v."#account_id" AS account_id,
    CAST(v.pay_amount AS DOUBLE)/NULLIF(e.exchange,0) AS revenue_usd
  FROM ta.v_event_18 v LEFT JOIN tc_blacklist b ON v."#user_id"=b.user_id
  LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange e ON v."$part_date"=e.ex_date AND v.pay_currency=e.currency
  WHERE v."$part_date"='2026-07-29' AND v."$part_event"='charge' AND b.user_id IS NULL
    AND CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP)<TIMESTAMP '2026-07-29 19:00:00'
    AND (v.sandbox IS NULL OR v.sandbox=FALSE) AND (v.is_freebuy IS NULL OR v.is_freebuy=FALSE)
),
sg_purchases AS (
  SELECT 'SG Android' AS cohort,CAST(TRY_CAST(v.product_id AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT),v."#account_id",CAST(v.pay_amount_usd AS DOUBLE)
  FROM ta.v_event_13 v LEFT JOIN sg_blacklist b ON v."#user_id"=b.user_id INNER JOIN sg_android a ON v."#user_id"=a.user_id INNER JOIN sg_country c ON v."#user_id"=c.user_id
  WHERE v."$part_date"='2026-05-08' AND v."$part_event"='charge' AND b.user_id IS NULL
    AND CAST(v."#event_time" AS TIMESTAMP)<TIMESTAMP '2026-05-08 19:00:00'
    AND (v.sandbox IS NULL OR v.sandbox=FALSE) AND (v.is_freebuy IS NULL OR v.is_freebuy=FALSE)
),
combined AS (SELECT * FROM tc_purchases UNION ALL SELECT * FROM sg_purchases),
cohort_sizes AS (SELECT 'TC 全量（仅安卓）' AS cohort,COUNT(*) AS cohort_users FROM tc_cohort UNION ALL SELECT 'SG Android',COUNT(*) FROM sg_cohort)
SELECT p.cohort,p.product_id,COALESCE(d."product_id@product_name_tc",'未匹配商品名') AS product_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.account_id) AS buyers,COUNT(*) AS orders,ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(p.revenue_usd,0)),2) AS revenue_usd,
  ROUND(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT p.account_id)/s.cohort_users,2) AS buyer_rate_pct
FROM combined p LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_13_0_20639 d ON p.product_id=CAST(TRY_CAST(d."product_id@product_id" AS DOUBLE) AS BIGINT)
LEFT JOIN cohort_sizes s ON p.cohort=s.cohort
GROUP BY 1,2,3,s.cohort_users
ORDER BY 1,revenue_usd DESC,buyers DESC;
